entry_points.text: Tracing anchors under resctrl with guard and include redirection; a warn helper reports leaf failures once with decimal and hex codes and the SVN leaf uses single-input convention.
Mapping validates permissions against page maxima, ensures address tracking, installs dedicated VM ops, records the enclave pointer and marks the area PFN-mapped, nonexpandable, nondumpable and IO.

Ioctl serializes per-enclave use with busy rejecting overlap, routes commands and reports unsupported; add-pages runs only on created-uninitialized, validates len, alignment, offset and security, strides pages yielding and aborting on signals.

Init requires created without initialized, stages signature and token at half-page with zeroed launch area and rejects vendors outside 0x0000 and 0x8086; provision gates on live matching descriptors recording the provisioning-key permission; SGX2 entries require readiness, validate and delegate, copying back result and progress.

exports.text: L2/L3 hooks always complete with wakeup, zero deltas and trace even when unsupported or counters fail; sampling blocks interrupts, forces prefetchers off with save/restore and uses fences.

Growth, shrink, backing, EPC alloc/free, virt translation, VA page/slot, young test, lookup, CPU mask, PTE zap, page alloc/load, reclaim mark, direct reclaim, key hash, attribute and restrict helpers are shared across enclave, ioctl and reclaim units.

hazards.text: Hardware results flag faulted completions with trap extraction, treating page-fault traps as non-failures while other faults and nonzero statuses fail.
This scope relies on external list, lock, MSR, user-copy, SRCU, mmap and scheduler helpers whose contracts live outside this dossier.

invariants.text: Enablement branch keys start false; per-CPU sync installs default IDs via the scheduler path; total maps to slot 0 and local to slot 1 with valid-bit filtering, rejecting others; reset restores defaults in memory then syncs hardware.

Create rejects replay and non-power-two sizes, sizes backing for payload plus overhead, issues hardware create, records base and attrs and publishes created only on success; backing places control after the extent advancing by fixed per-page extent.

EPC virt derives from section base plus index stride; slot uses lowest clear bit as byte offset multiple and is full when none clear; age deems idle only when every attached space reports not accessed.

Secinfo allows only regular and TCS with no write-without-read and zero TCS perms; offset/len require alignment without wrap and containment; page alloc derives max protections with TCS forced RW; low add pins user source requiring exec; outer add inserts index before hardware add incrementing child with optional measurement; extend steps the page in fixed blocks.

Init denies attrs outside the mask and reserved intersections and hashes the modulus into four-word signer; EINIT runs under mutex with preemption off around hash refresh programming four consecutive registers, retrying with spins then sleeps on unmasked events and mapping faults to IO error and other codes to permission failure.

Restrict reclaims then loads each page allowing only regular pages, issues permission change, syncs tracking with a kick and retry, and reports progress; direct reclaim triggers when free pages drop below a threshold.

Load faults when the frame is absent and reports busy when concurrently reclaiming, otherwise ensures control resident and reloads via ELDU clearing linkage and incrementing child; reload maps content and metadata, issues hardware reload, clears and dirties metadata, and truncates only when fully zero with no sibling reclaiming in 32-entry groups.

Mapping permission checks reject ranges outside an initialized enclave and read-implies-exec tasks, scanning the page index with periodic lock drops; unmapped selection rejects private mappings and honors fixed addresses.

locks.text: Cache QoS requires hotplug protection, rejects levels other than 2 and 3, builds a mask of every member or one representative per configurability, and applies synchronously on selected CPUs; global usage counting is guarded by the SVN mutex.

Node free-list edits occur under node spin with poison segregated and counts outside; reclaim edits occur under reclaimer spin with ref held and hardware steps under enclave mutex; roster traversal uses SRCU with pinning and mmap read locking; zap snapshots version and repeats when changed with mask built likewise.

Tracking requires the address write lock, skips already-tracked spaces, registers the notifier before publishing under spin with barrier and version bump; reclaim marking flips the tracked flag and list linkage under reclaimer spin.

state_machines.text: CDP enable validates capability, updates hardware config, then records the flag; disable clears hardware first when previously enabled and always leaves the flag cleared.

Open acquires usage, allocates refcount, index, mutex, lists and SRCU, unwinding on failure; SVN refresh is no-op without capability, warns with users, retries entropy boundedly and maps failures, running only zero-to-one; release drains entries, syncs SRCU and drops refs.

Alloc loops node-aware retrieval, fails when none reclaimable, disallowed or signaled, otherwise reclaims and reschedules and wakes below watermark; reclaim detaches a batch, keeps aged with backing, unmaps and blocks, writes survivors, clears linkage, frees slots and evicts control when last child goes.

Growth increments tally and materializes a tracking page only on boundary with linkage undone on failure; eviction consumes head slot and retires full pages; writeback retries tracking then fencing with cross-CPU kick before recording the slot or releasing on failure.
Enclaves move created to initialized exactly once with entry rejecting missing creation or replay; SGX2 restrict and modify require initialized plus processor support.

structs.text: Residency tallies hold four u64 hit/miss snapshots; scattered descriptors pack feature, register, bit, leaf and subleaf with a zero terminator; counters request raw kernel-only pinned starts; invalid index is max uint; three globals mask reserved enclave attribute bits.

Enclaves carry flags, tally, roster, backing, control, base, size and attrs; pages carry guest, version, reclaim flag, owner, memory, type, version page and ceiling; VA pages carry link and bitmap; backing carries content/control plus offset; bundles carry guest, payload, metadata and control.

Ioctls expose create, add, init, provision, restrict, modify and remove with busy/created/debug/initialized and reclaim markers; secinfo uses regular/TCS with RWX bits plus reserved masks; init enforces attribute masks and hashes the modulus for signer.
